rca_of_the_issue.bug: GET /api/projects/{project_id} returned HTTP 500 KeyError:'updated_at' for chat projects auto-created via POST /api/chat/message.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1) POST /api/chat/message without project_id → response.project_id=X. 2) GET /api/projects/X → was 500 (KeyError).
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The auto-create insert in send_chat_message didn't write 'updated_at'. The list endpoint had a safe backfill; the single-project detail endpoint did not, so it raised KeyError when Pydantic serialized via response_model=Project.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: server.py L3311-3322 now mirrors the list endpoint backfill: normalizes created_at (str→datetime), populates updated_at from created_at when missing, backfills ai_mode from ai_source when missing. All four branches tested green.
